title.value: AB-2515 Menstrual products: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS)

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) means a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 25258.4. (a) On or before July 1, 2029, a manufacturer of a menstrual product, as defined in this article, shall register with the department and provide to the department all of the following...
